title: Article-Code
summary: A collection of research-article code comparing synthetic data generation techniques (Gaussian copula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN, TVAE) on healthcare tabular datasets (cardiovascular disease, obesity, diabetes, prostate cancer), including in-tree copies of CTGAN's transformer code and direct calls to the SDV, SDGym and SDMetrics libraries for generation and benchmarking. SDV's single-table synthesizers and SDGym's benchmark_single_table are run to fit and compare generative models, while ctgan/rdt source is vendored in-tree.
needs: No README; repo bundles several sub-projects (STDG, SDgym, SDV, margctgan, 3S-Testing, SynMeter) with both vendored ctgan/rdt copies and direct SDV/SDGym/SDMetrics calls — unclear if all sub-projects are equally active or some are unused templates; authorship/affiliation unverifiable without README.
